Doi Mae Tho summit
trails.why: Doi Mae Tho, also known as Doi Langka Luang or Doi Lang Ka, is a mountain in Thailand, part of the Khun Tan Range.

trails.name: Khao Luang summit
trails.why: Khao Luang is the tallest mountain in southern Thailand. It is in Nakhon Si Thammarat Province.

trails.name: Doi Luang summit
trails.why: Doi Luang is a 1,694 m high mountain in Thailand, part of the Phi Pan Nam Range. The mountain rises at the western end of Ban Tun Subdistrict, Mueang Phayao District, Phayao Province, near the point where the limit of this province meets with Lampang Province.
